scope: Fresh Release production schgen executable compilation and link, measured separately from configuration, catalog generation, dependencies, tests, board generation, rendering and audits.

environment.prebuilt_dependencies: existing verified zlib-ng and installed system libraries

immediate_no_change_rebuild.meaning: Not an edited-source incremental compile measurement

smoke.limits: Project input checks, not full board gates. Circuit part counts exclude additional PCB-only items.

step_timing_semantics: Ninja elapsed task times overlap across the two workers; do not sum as process-wall time. This run does not isolate header parsing from optimization/code generation.
operational_note: The current CMake target publishes native/bin/schgen in the source tree. No competing build ran. The fresh directory is retained because the binary's authoring audit configuration references its compile commands. It occupies approximately 67 MB. A future rebuild must regenerate matching toolchain provenance before removing this directory.
limitations: One sample, no OS cache flush, no CPU-heavy concurrent agent jobs. No Python compile percentage: historical baseline is interpreted and this metric is not comparable to board execution. No full-suite or new board qualification claim. Previous board timings predate the audit-header coverage correction.
